answer: An agent marketplace requires each identity to lock a refundable bond for 30 days before bidding for work, with one bond backing only one active identity. Whether agents sell dune maps, island routes, or relic scans, creating extra names unlocks no free bidding slots. An attacker running 1,000 identities must immobilize 1,000 bonds for the full period, paying the financing cost and losing access to that capital even if every bond is eventually returned.
